q1.explanationZh: arch 名词“拱”，也可作动词“（使）成弓形”，如 arch one’s back“弓着背”。

q2.explanationZh: architect“建筑师”，注意 ch 读 /k/。

q3.explanationZh: architect 指人“建筑师”，architecture 指“建筑学；建筑式样”。

q4.explanationZh: Arctic“北极（的）”，常大写，the Arctic Ocean“北冰洋”；注意 Arc 后面还有 t。

q5.explanationZh: area“地区；面积”，如 be large in area“面积大”。

q6.explanationZh: argue“争论；主张”，argue that... 表示“认为……”。

q7.explanationZh: argue 的名词是 argument，注意去掉 e 再加 -ment。

q8.explanationZh: arise 不及物动词“出现；产生”，变化 arise–arose–arisen。

q9.explanationZh: arithmetic“算术”，be good at arithmetic“擅长算术”。

q10.explanationZh: arm 作名词“手臂”，复数 arms 可表示“武器”；作动词“武装；配备”。

q11.explanationZh: army“军队；陆军”，join the army“参军”。

q12.explanationZh: around 作介词“在……周围”，作副词“在周围；大约”。

q13.explanationZh: arouse“引起；唤起”，如 arouse interest/discussion“引起兴趣/讨论”。

q14.explanationZh: arrange“安排”，注意双写 r，名词是 arrangement。

q15.explanationZh: arrange 加 -ment 构成名词 arrangement“安排”，保留词尾 e。

q16.explanationZh: arrest 动词、名词同形，“逮捕”。

q17.explanationZh: arrive 去 e 加 -al 构成名词 arrival“到达”。

q18.explanationZh: arrive 不及物动词，arrive at（小地方）/ in（大地方）“到达”。

q20.explanationZh: art“艺术；美术”，复数 arts 可表示“文科”；art museum“美术馆”。

q21.explanationZh: article“文章；物品”，write an article on...“写一篇关于……的文章”。

q23.explanationZh: art 加 -ist 表示人，artist“艺术家”。

q24.explanationZh: as 作连词“当……时；像……一样”，作介词“作为”。

q25.explanationZh: ash“灰”，复数 ashes 表示“灰烬”。

q26.explanationZh: ashamed 形容词“惭愧的”，be ashamed of“为……感到羞愧”。

q27.explanationZh: Asia“亚洲”是专有名词，首字母大写；形容词 Asian。

q28.explanationZh: aside 副词“在旁边；到一边”，set aside“留出；把……放在一边”。

q29.explanationZh: ask“问；请求”，ask for“要求”，ask sb. to do sth.“请某人做某事”。

q30.explanationZh: asleep 是形容词“睡着的”，常作表语，fall asleep“入睡”。

q31.explanationZh: aspect“方面”，in many aspects“在许多方面”。

q33.explanationZh: assemble“集合；装配”，注意双写 s，结尾 -ble。

q34.explanationZh: ask a favor of sb.“请某人帮个忙”，介词用 of。

q35.explanationZh: ask about“询问，打听”，about 后接要打听的事。

q36.explanationZh: ask after sb.“问候某人；询问某人的近况”。

q37.explanationZh: arrange sth. for sb.“给某人准备某物”，介词用 for。

q38.explanationZh: arrange to do sth.“安排做某事”，arrange 后接不定式。

q39.explanationZh: as is known to all“众所周知”，as 引导非限制性定语从句，指代后面整句话。

q40.explanationZh: as a matter of fact“事实上”，相当于 in fact。

q41.explanationZh: as a result“因此”；as a result of 后接名词表示“由于”。

q42.explanationZh: as a whole“作为整体；总体上”。

q43.explanationZh: as far as“就……而言；远到……”，如 as far as I know“据我所知”。

q45.explanationZh: as long as“只要；长达……”，表示条件时相当于 only if。

q46.explanationZh: as often as“每次，每当”，相当于 whenever。

q47.explanationZh: as well as“除……之外；和”，连接主语时谓语与前面的主语一致。

q48.explanationZh: be ashamed to do sth.“羞于做某事”，ashamed 后接不定式。

q49.explanationZh: “发表在报纸上”的是文章，my 后接名词单数 article。

q50.explanationZh: in many aspects“在很多方面”，many 后用复数 aspects。

q52.explanationZh: ask a favor of sb.“请某人帮忙”，need to 后用动词原形 ask。

q53.explanationZh: as a whole“作为整体，总体上”。

q54.explanationZh: artificial intelligence“人工智能”，修饰名词用形容词 artificial。

q55.explanationZh: the 后接名词，“货物到达”= the arrival of the goods。

q56.explanationZh: arm oneself with...“用……武装自己”，与 thought 一致用过去式 armed。

q57.explanationZh: 活动是“被社区安排的”，用过去分词 arranged 作后置定语。

q58.explanationZh: has 后接过去分词构成现在完成时，arouse a heated discussion“引起热议”。

q59.sampleAnswer: His speech at the meeting aroused a heated discussion among experts and netizens.
references: His speech at the meeting aroused a heated discussion among experts and netizens.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “引起热议”= arouse a heated discussion；“网民”= netizens。

q60.sampleAnswer: It took hundreds of years to build the canal, which still serves as the major waterway running east-west although it is not as busy as it used to be.
references: It took hundreds of years to build the canal, which still serves as the major waterway running east-west although it is not as busy as it used to be.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “不如以前繁忙”= not as busy as it used to be；“花了……年做某事”= It took ... years to do sth.。

q61.sampleAnswer: AI has gradually integrated into creative arts, filling life with a delightful surprise.
references: AI has gradually integrated into creative arts, filling life with a delightful surprise.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “创意艺术”= creative arts；“融入”= integrate into；现在分词短语 filling... 表结果。

q62.sampleAnswer: If (it is) not carefully arranged, tomorrow’s trip to the art museum will turn into a hasty tour.
references: If (it is) not carefully arranged, tomorrow’s trip to the art museum will turn into a hasty tour.
If it is not carefully arranged, tomorrow’s trip to the art museum will turn into a hasty tour.
If not carefully arranged, tomorrow’s trip to the art museum will turn into a hasty tour.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 行程是“被安排的”，用 If (it is) not carefully arranged 省略结构；“走马观花”可译为 a hasty tour。

q63.sampleAnswer: Don’t forget to ask after your aunt when you see Tom this evening.
references: Don’t forget to ask after your aunt when you see Tom this evening.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “问候某人”= ask after sb.；“别忘记做某事”= Don’t forget to do sth.。

q64.sampleAnswer: Artificial intelligence is far from all-powerful, both at present time and for the foreseeable future.
references: Artificial intelligence is far from all-powerful, both at present time and for the foreseeable future.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “人工智能”= artificial intelligence；“远非”= far from；“无所不能的”= all-powerful。

q65.sampleAnswer: Nowadays, an increasing number of people argue that seeking fashion too much is equal to abandoning one’s freedom of choice.
references: Nowadays, an increasing number of people argue that seeking fashion too much is equal to abandoning one’s freedom of choice.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “认为”= argue that...；“越来越多的人”= an increasing number of people；be equal to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

q66.sampleAnswer: He appears to be strong and healthy, but, as a matter of fact, he has been suffering from depression for many years.
references: He appears to be strong and healthy, but, as a matter of fact, he has been suffering from depression for many years.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “其实”= as a matter of fact；“患……多年”用现在完成进行时 has been suffering from。

q67.sampleAnswer: You’d better not drink any strong tea before you go to bed, which will make it difficult for you to fall asleep.
references: You’d better not drink any strong tea before you go to bed, which will make it difficult for you to fall asleep.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “最好不要”= had better not do；“入睡”= fall asleep；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。

q68.sampleAnswer: As is well known, books teach us to learn life, truth, science and many other useful things.
references: As is well known, books teach us to learn life, truth, science and many other useful things.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “众所周知”= As is well known，as 指代后面整句话。
